ITEM.PTXT: When any of the following operations is performed, controlled driving by the radar cruise control system is cancelled and, except when the main switch is pressed, the radar cruise control system is put in standby.

ENTRY.PTXT: Pull the cruise control main switch toward you. (CANCEL switch ON)
Press the main switch of the cruise control main switch. (Main switch OFF)
Depress the brake pedal. (Stop light switch assembly ON)
Shift the shift position to a position other than "D".
With the shift position in "D", shift to 3, 2 or 1 by operating the transmission shift switch.
